en_title: Battlefield 6's Successful Launch Nets EA CEO $38 Million Payday After Layoffs to Development Team
cn_title: 《战地风云6》热卖后，EA首席执行官获3865万美元(约合人民币3亿元)薪酬
subtitle: 开发者却被裁
opus_summary: 《战地风云6》大卖后，EA首席执行官Andrew Wilson在2026财年获3865万美元(约合人民币3亿元)薪酬，较前一年多800万美元(约合人民币5424万元)。EA同年3月裁掉各《战地风云》团队数量不明的员工。

translated_terms.Public Investment Fund: 沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金

通行中文片名，待用户确认。

paragraphs.en: EA’s CEO got an $8 million raise thanks to how well Battlefield 6 performed — four months after the devs responsible for making the game got laid off.
paragraphs.cn: EA首席执行官因《战地风云6》表现出色获得800万美元(约合人民币5424万元)的加薪，而负责开发该游戏的开发者在四个月前被裁员。

paragraphs.en: Battlefield 6 was the , beating out Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and NBA 2K26. It sold over seven million copies in just three days and was the best-selling title across both Xbox and PC at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 《战地风云6》击败了《使命召唤：黑色行动7》和《NBA 2K26》。它仅用三天就卖出逾700万份，当时在XBOX和PC两大平台均为销量最高的作品。

paragraphs.en: However, in March 2026 — just five months after celebrating the most successful launch in the Battlefield franchise ever — EA laid off an undetermined number of employees across all its Battlefield teams to “better align” itself around “what matters most to our community.”
paragraphs.cn: 不过，2026年3月——也就是《战地风云》系列庆祝史上最成功首发仅五个月后——EA在旗下各《战地风云》团队裁掉了数量未明的员工，称此举是为了更好地围绕「对社区最重要的事」调整自身方向。

paragraphs.en: Now, come July, one of EA’s SEC filings have been released, showing that CEO Andrew Wilson’s total compensation for the 2026 fiscal year added up to $38,649,984.
paragraphs.cn: 如今到了7月，EA一份提交给美国证券交易委员会的文件披露，其首席执行官Andrew Wilson在2026财年的总薪酬为38,649,984美元(约合人民币3亿元)。

paragraphs.en: As pointed out by PC Gamer, this is an $8 million increase from his total compensation from the previous year, and he has Battlefield 6’s success to thank for it.
paragraphs.cn: 正如PC Gamer指出的那样，这比他上一年的总薪酬增加了800万美元(约合人民币5424万元)，而他要感谢《战地风云6》的成功。

paragraphs.en: The filing credits Battlefield 6’s high sales for allowing EA to meet company objectives, saying the game had a “high-quality launch” with “positive critical reviews and stable services and gameplay, with interim milestones related to future launches being met.” It also states that the game’s “highly successful launch” helped manage the company’s resilience in an “unpredictable external environment.”
paragraphs.cn: 该文件将EA完成公司目标归功于《战地风云6》的高销量，称该游戏实现了「高质量的首发」，并且「获得积极的媒体评测，服务和游戏体验稳定，与未来发布相关的中期里程碑也已达成」。文件还称，该游戏「极为成功的首发」帮助公司在「不可预测的外部环境」中维持韧性。

paragraphs.en: While reception to Battlefield 6 has had its ups and downs in recent months, it’s showing no signs of slowing on the content side, receiving a collaboration with Top Gun as part of Season 4. The collab, which drops in August, includes two fighter jets and skins of characters in the film, complete with full voice acting.
paragraphs.cn: 近几个月来《战地风云6》的口碑虽有起伏，但内容更新没有放缓的迹象：第4赛季将联动《壮志凌云》。这项8月上线的联动将加入两架战斗机和电影角色皮肤，且均配有完整配音。

paragraphs.en: In June, IGN spoke with Ariel Giovannetti , Seasonal and Competitive Creative Lead, Motive, Battlefield Studios, who assured fans that their feedback about the game is being heard and that the team was pleased with how things shook out in Season 3.
paragraphs.cn: 6月，IGN采访了Battlefield Studios旗下Motive的赛季与竞技创意主管Ariel Giovannetti。他向粉丝保证，团队听到了他们对游戏的反馈，也对第3赛季的最终成果感到满意。

paragraphs.en: “I hope the roadmap shows that we are listening, that we are working towards those goals that the community is setting for us, but at the same time we're moving responsively because Battlefield is huge,” he told us.
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉我们：「我希望路线图能表明我们正在倾听，我们正朝着社区为我们设定的目标努力；但与此同时，我们也会灵活应变，因为《战地风云》规模庞大。」

paragraphs.en: “...our goal was to reach out to our fans, was to reach out to our current players, show them that we care, show them that the future is bright, that we are going to be applying a lot of changes, that we're going to be doing a lot of things, that is what the community wants and we're very happy with that.”
paragraphs.cn: 「……我们的目标是接触粉丝，接触现有玩家，让他们看到我们关心他们，看到未来一片光明；我们会推出许多改动，也会做许多社区想要的事，我们对此很高兴。」

paragraphs.en: This news follows EA's 2025 aquisition to a private investor group in a record-breaking $55 billion deal , made up of Saudia Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners, who now have a 100% ownership of the company.
paragraphs.cn: 这则消息紧随EA在2025年被私募投资者团体收购之后；这笔创纪录交易的原文金额写作55 billion，即550亿美元(约合人民币3729亿元)。该团体由沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金、Silver Lake和Affinity Partners组成，现已100%持有该公司。
